headline: Food Safety Officer
summary: Food safety officer with ten years in food manufacturing and hotel kitchens around Metro Manila. I develop and run food safety programmes, audit kitchens and plants, act on violations and train staff on hazards. I have led two sites through FSSC 22000 and HACCP certification.
skills: Food safety principles and hazard analysis

experience.title: Food Safety Officer
bullets: Lead food safety for a plant producing sauces and frozen meals for 300 supermarkets.
Wrote and maintain the HACCP plan and prerequisite programmes; led the plant to FSSC 22000 certification.
Audit production lines and suppliers and stop lines when critical limits are breached.
Train 180 workers each year on hygiene, allergens and hazard control.
Supervise three quality technicians and handle regulator inspections.

experience.title: Hygiene and Food Safety Supervisor
bullets: Inspected five hotel kitchens daily and kept temperature and cleaning records.
Worked with chefs on safe preparation methods for banquets.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Food Technology
education.school: Metro East College of Food Science
